provenance.galleryTitle: Six fresh sounds — does the old matching recipe help?
galleryIntro: Six new-to-this-listening-study tagged sounds. Existing inverse models propose the same candidates to two matching objectives.

Both general-synth fits get two starts and 1,024 native refinement attempts: original MatchObjective versus the learned preference selector. Original Bfxr remains a separate third option with its own optimizer.

Choose the closest, then how close. Optional mismatch questions appear while the sounds remain available. All six files occur in historical original-Bfxr training; source families may overlap. No model improvement is assumed.
provenance.scope: Fresh to retained feedback, prior exact files and audition PCM excluded. Repeated source families and historical Bfxr training may overlap. Existing inverse weights; equal general-arm proposal/refinement budgets, independent original Bfxr budget2000. No quality claim.
provenance.selectionPolicy: Each arm selects only from common raw plus its own refinements. Legacy winner, preference winner, original Bfxr. Deduplicate exact PCM with role aliases; no replacement to force variety. All six references.

diagnosticQuestion.storage: Scoped target note with exact candidate IDs; unchanged schema3
